acq.Description: Signal class defined by the source: focal = both signals recorded at 'focal EEG channels' (channels that detected the first ictal EEG signal changes, judged by at least two board-certified electroencephalographers); nonfocal = both signals recorded at channels not involved at seizure onset.

pair_index.Description: Index of the signal pair in the source (1-3750 per class); the number in the source file name Data_<F|N>_Ind<index>.txt. Pairs were stored by the source in the order in which they were randomly drawn; patient, channel and time window of origin were not stored by the source.

source_archive.Description: Source zip archive (copied byte-identically to sourcedata/upf-repositori-10230-42829/).

source_member.Description: Text file inside the source archive from which this run was converted.

source_member_sha256.Description: SHA-256 of the uncompressed source text file.

stationarity_test_S.Description: Published outcome of the stationarity test for this pair, copied from Results_<F|N>_All.txt (column SF/SN) of Andrzejak et al. (2012). Analysis result, not a property of the recording.

randomness_test_Ux.Description: Published outcome of the randomness test for signal x (column UxF/UxN of Results_<F|N>_All.txt).

randomness_test_Uy.Description: Published outcome of the randomness test for signal y (column UyF/UyN of Results_<F|N>_All.txt).

nonlinear_independence_test_B.Description: Published outcome of the nonlinear-independence test for the pair (column BF/BN of Results_<F|N>_All.txt).
